name: leadgen-tools-mcp

tools.name: leadgen_find_companies
tools.description: Real businesses for a niche and a city from Google Maps (up to 60 per call, paginated), optionally with the emails on their websites and verified ones from our data partners. Credits: 2 per page + per email delivered (each company is charged once per 30 days).

query.description: What businesses, e.g. "dental clinics" (not needed with page_token).

with_emails.description: true: read each website for emails (and fill misses with verified ones).

tools.name: leadgen_find_people
tools.description: The decision makers at one company, ranked by who decides on buying what you sell, with verified emails (A = verified, A- = very likely). Credits: 2 per person with a verified email, 1 without.

domain.description: Company website or domain, e.g. acme.com.

offer.description: What you sell (max 300 chars): the ranking uses it.

lookup.description: false = names and titles only, no email lookups.

tools.name: leadgen_verify_emails
tools.description: Check up to 20 email addresses (syntax, domain, mailbox, disposable) before using them. Free.

tools.name: leadgen_contact_check
tools.description: ALWAYS call before contacting anyone. For each person (email and/or LinkedIn URL, optional website): verdict ok | wait | blocked with the reasons (on the do-not-contact list, bounced, said no, replied, in a running sequence, contacted by a teammate's agent in the last 30 days, LinkedIn already invited, a colleague at the same company contacted recently) and the last touch. Free. Max 200 per call.

tools.name: leadgen_save_prospects
tools.description: Save prospects you found anywhere (LinkedIn, Maps, a website, a directory) to the team's one list. Each needs an email or a LinkedIn URL. People already in the account are reported as duplicate with where they are; every result carries the contact_check verdict. Free. Max 200.

project.description: Project name (default "Agent prospects", created when missing).

agent.description: Who is acting, shown to the team: e.g. "Ana's Claude", "OpenClaw sales bot".

tools.name: leadgen_search_prospects
tools.description: Search the team's prospects by email, name, company or website. Free.

tools.name: leadgen_log_activity
tools.description: Log what you did outside LeadGen.tools campaigns, right after doing it, so the rest of the team's agents know: email_sent, linkedin_invite, linkedin_accepted, linkedin_message, whatsapp_sent, call, meeting, reply (their answer, any channel: stops their campaign emails), note, not_interested / opt_out (do-not-contact for everyone). Free.

text.description: The note or message you sent, or their answer.

agent.description: Who is acting, shown to the team: e.g. "Ana's Claude", "OpenClaw sales bot".

tools.name: leadgen_timeline
tools.description: Everything that happened with one person, whoever did it: what agents logged, every campaign email and their replies, newest first, plus whether they may be contacted now. Free.

tools.name: leadgen_projects
tools.description: List the account's projects (lists of prospects). Free.

tools.name: leadgen_sending_accounts
tools.description: The team's connected mailboxes (Gmail and SMTP) campaigns send from. Free.

tools.name: leadgen_campaigns
tools.description: List the account's campaigns, or one campaign in detail with id. Free.

tools.name: leadgen_campaign_status
tools.description: Progress of one campaign: sent, follow-ups, replies, bounces, next send. Free.

tools.name: leadgen_replies
tools.description: Who answered a campaign, with the AI's category (interested, meeting, question, not_interested…) and summary. Use category "hot" for interested + meeting + question. Free.

tools.name: leadgen_linkedin_tasks
tools.description: The LinkedIn follow-up of campaigns for an agent with the user's browser: without campaign_id, which campaigns have LinkedIn work; with it, each person's next action (invite / check / message) with the exact note or message and the daily limits. To mark progress use state (invited | accepted | messaged | replied | skipped | not_found) with lead_id. Free.

text.description: With state replied: their LinkedIn answer (it is classified like an email reply).

tools.name: leadgen_whatsapp_tasks
tools.description: The WhatsApp follow-up of a campaign: everyone who got the first email and has a phone, whether it is on WhatsApp, the message and the chat link. Mark with state (sent | skipped | no_whatsapp) and lead_id. Free.

instructions:
LeadGen.tools is the shared office of a sales team whose members each run their own AI agent. Three rules keep the agents from stepping on each other:
1) Before you write to, invite or message ANYONE (email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, phone), call leadgen_contact_check. Contact only verdict "ok". "wait" means a teammate or a campaign is already on it, or a colleague at that company was contacted recently: do not write. "blocked" means never.
2) Every prospect you find, wherever you found it, goes to leadgen_save_prospects (one shared list, duplicates are detected across the team). Pass agent = who you are, e.g. "Ana's Claude".
3) Anything you do outside LeadGen.tools campaigns (a LinkedIn invitation or message, a WhatsApp, an email from someone's own mailbox, a call, their answer, a "no") goes to leadgen_log_activity right after. A reply or a "no" stops that person's campaign emails for everyone.
For emailing at volume, do not send from a personal mailbox: create or use a LeadGen.tools campaign (it rotates the team's mailboxes, respects daily limits, verifies every address and stops follow-ups on any reply).
Never invent emails or phone numbers. Data partners' names are never shown to the user.
